purpose: Input datum for every I calibration input: command, recorded acquisition bias, and role. The bias is part of the input; a model run without it is not a comparison against this recording.

inputs.role: reserved fitting holdout; sweep and bias not read by this datum

decision.prior_residuals: Every I model residual before 2026-09-06 used bias 0 nA.
decision.evidence: Source model at 0.19 nA, nseg x9, CVode 1e-10: bias 0 gives 11 events and first onset +11.71 ms; measured bias gives 22 events and first onset -3.24 ms (h01-pv-neuron-bias-control / -bias-measured). Both changes exceed every decision limit and every allowance.
decision.rule: Zero-bias I residuals are retired as contract comparisons. Every I candidate evaluation applies the recorded bias of its input from t=0. The candidate's own bias-on response is the first Stage 0 evaluation of the I campaign.

limit: Bias applied from t=0 does not reproduce the acquisition history before the 750 ms crop; slow-state equilibration remains an assumption.
